title: NEGATIVE CONTROL - deliberately wrong expectation
description: This scenario is INTENTIONALLY WRONG. It claims a low-battery frame leaves the computer in NOMINAL. The simulator correctly enters SAFE_MODE, so the runner MUST report FAIL and exit non-zero. It lives outside scenarios/*.json so it never runs in the normal suite; scripts/run_demo.sh uses it to show that failures are detected.
inject: TELEMETRY seq=2 battery_v=6.5 temp_c=22.5 attitude_deg=2.0 comm=UP sensors=VALID
